name: Anarchist's Cookbook
dropNote: Warlock Campaign Boss - Alpha guaranteed drop on first kill.

talent.name: Perfectly Wicked
talent.desc: Applying a status effect increases total weapon damage by 20% for 15s.

name: Axel
flavorText: "Don't fear your instincts, society taught you how to fail."

name: Backbone
flavorText:
"Your first kill is hard. But it gets easier the more you do it."
- The Strategist

name: Bulldog
flavorText: No sweat.

name: Cap'n
flavorText: "Get behind me."

talent.name: Perfect Clutch
talent.desc: If you are below 50% armor, critical hits repair 3% missing armor.

name: Festive Delivery
flavorText: "You get fireworks, and you get fireworks. Everybody gets fireworks!"

talent.name: Perfect Combined Arms
talent.desc: Shooting an enemy increases total skill damage by 40% for 3s.

name: Lavoisier
flavorText: "A piece of perfection, if you understand what you can do with it." Anonymous

name: Liquid Engineer
flavorText:
"Is that oil, or blood?"

- BTSU Combat Medic

name: Matador
flavorText:
"I used to dance with death itself, but grew tired of the performance. I think I prefer having the odds stacked against me instead."

- The Bull

name: Momma Badger
flavorText: Not in my burrows.

name: Percussive Maintenance
flavorText: "Have you tried turning it off and on again?”

name: Proxy
flavorText:
"Hostile detected. Hostile eliminated."
- Alexander Ortiz

name: Strategic Alignment
flavorText: "I know this is going to look like we’re destroying everything. Don’t worry about it. We don’t make mistakes. Just happy accidents.”

name: The Courier
flavorText: "May this carry your soul to paradise." The Priest

talent.name: Perfect Vigilance
talent.desc: Increases total weapon damage by 30%. Taking damage disables this buff for 3s.

name: Vigil
flavorText: “Honor the fallen.”

name: Benefactor
flavorText: I can assure you we can all benefit from this.

name: Bober
flavorText:
"No way they can get me in this."
- Diesel

name: Carpenter
flavorText:
"The things I break stay broken."
- The Strategist

name: Chainkiller
flavorText:
"Ninety-nine bottles of beer on the wall, ninety-nine bottles of beer. Shoot one down, watch it explode, ninety-eight bottles of beer on the wall..."

- Bored True Sons marksman

name: Combustor
flavorText:
"My operatives would never be left alone in the field."
- Natalya Sokolova

talent.name: Perfect Spark
talent.desc: Damaging an enemy with a skill increases total weapon damage by 20% for 15s.

name: Equalizer
flavorText: Building them up to bring them down,

name: Everyday Carrier
flavorText:
"What's in my everyday carry? As many armor plates as I can fit."

- Agent Sanders

name: Ferocious Calm
flavorText: "The invention of the gun required a redefinition of courage from aggressive ferocity to calmness under fire.” - Robert L. O’Connell

name: Henri
flavorText: "We live together, we learn together, we die together. But, first we make each other stronger." Anonymous

name: Hunter-Killer
dropNote: Unique reward from the Haven "ivory key" box for killing all the Warlock Hunters.

talent.name: Perfect Intimidate
talent.desc: While you have bonus armor, increases total weapon damage by 60% to enemies within 10m.

name: Impetus
flavorText: "Don't stop, can't stop, won't stop."

name: Pointman
dropNote: Warlock Campaign Boss - Charlie guaranteed drop on first kill.

talent.name: Perfect Vanguard
talent.desc:
Deploying a shield makes it invulnerable for 6s and grants 60% of your armor as bonus armor to all other allies for 12s.
Cooldown: 30s.

name: Pristine Example
flavorText: “Only the first shot is clean. Everything after that is just messy.”

name: Robin
flavorText: I paid for all the guns so I'm going to use all of the guns.

name: Sleight
flavorText: "I'm feeling generous."

name: The Sacrifice
flavorText: “Only after everything has been given, can you expect to receive. When the vessel is empty, the soul is complete.”

name: Zero F’s
flavorText: "Here is the field where I grow my Fs, lo it lies fallow."

name: Contractor's Gloves
flavorText: “Never met a man I couldn’t break. Apply enough pressure on a small enough point, and anything cracks.”

name: Deathgrips
flavorText: “Most people are white-knuckling their way through life, stress levels off the charts. Working dead-end jobs, paying off their loans, student debts, fucking lattes. That shit will kill you without clarity in your life. And nothing brings clarity like hanging off the side of a mountain.”

name: Eagle's Grasp
flavorText:
"Just wait until I get my hands on them."
- Saint

name: Firm Handshake
flavorText: “You can tell a lot about a person from their handshake. It’s also a great pathogenic delivery system.”

name: Ammo Dump
flavorText:
"Whaddya mean yer outta ammo? Dig around in that mess you call a holster and find something to shove in your gun and shoot!"
- True Sons platoon leader

name: Claws Out
flavorText: "Rip and Tear"

name: Forge
flavorText: "The space between is where you want to be. Not the hammer. Not the anvil. You are the impact; the energy. The potential. Bend or break, you will find purpose. And in purpose, there is truth.”

name: Salvo
flavorText: Gone in a flash.

name: Spot-on
flavorText: "It's all in the hip."

name: Cloak
flavorText: "No sudden movements."

name: Emperors Guard
flavorText: "Fall down seven times, get up eight"

name: Fox's Prayer
flavorText: “Ever heard of an atheist in a foxhole? Me neither.”
fixedAttributes: Damage to Targets Out of Cover

name: Grease
flavorText: "I'm not in danger. I am the danger."

name: Snowmaker
flavorText: "Like our friends down under, if we want Snow on Christmas we have to make it ourselves."

name: Turmoil
flavorText: Never let them know your next move.

name: Chill Out
flavorText:
"Revenge is a dish best served cold."
- Someone who remembers you

name: Nightwatcher
flavorText: “Through glass and steel; looking at you; a view so cruel.”

name: Punch Drunk
flavorText: “If the first shot doesn’t drop ‘em, the second one will. Or the third. Third’s usually good.”

name: The Hollow Man
flavorText: “No whimper. No bang. Just silence. The end of all things.”

name: Visionario
flavorText:
“So far be distant; and good night, sweet friend."
- A Midsummer Night’s Dream
